title: Real Estate Agent Assist
description: Assist real estate agents in managing client inquiries and generating leads.

prompt-variables.title: Real estate agent name
prompt-variables.display-description: The name of the real estate agent.
prompt-variables.editor-llm-description: The name of the real estate agent.

prompt-variables.title: Agency name
prompt-variables.display-description: The name of the real estate agency.
prompt-variables.editor-llm-description: The name of the real estate agency or brokerage the agent represents.
prompt-variables.placeholder: Exp: A real estate business focused on buying and selling residential properties.

prompt-variables.title: Activity area
prompt-variables.display-description: Which geographical area the agent operates in.
prompt-variables.editor-llm-description: The specific geographical area or neighborhood where the real estate agent primarily operates. This helps the agent provide relevant information to clients.

prompt-variables.title: Available properties
prompt-variables.display-description: Details about the properties and listings available for sale or rent.
prompt-variables.editor-llm-description: Clear, detailed information about the properties the agent can offer, including features, locations, and prices. This will help the agent provide accurate information to clients.
prompt-variables.placeholder: e.g. 2-bedroom apartments in downtown Toronto starting at $800,000.

prompt-variables.title: Greeting
prompt-variables.display-description: The initial greeting message for users.
prompt-variables.editor-llm-description: The initial greeting message the agent should use. Something like: "Hi, I'm John's assistant, what can I do for you?
prompt-variables.default-value: Hi there! I'm ${AgentName}, here to to help you find the perfect home.
prompt-variables.placeholder: e.g. Hi there! I'm ${AgentName}, here to to help you find the perfect home
